title: On the Lei--Bai conjecture on $5$-regular Lin--Lu--Yau Ricci-flat graphs
summary: We study the Ricci curvature introduced by Lin, Lu, and Yau. A graph is called Ricci-flat if every edge has curvature zero. Lei and Bai classified $5$-regular symmetric Ricci-flat graphs by proving that every such graph is isomorphic to a particular $72$-vertex graph $\RF$, and conjectured that every $5$-regular Ricci-flat graph is either isomorphic to $\RF$ or admits a nontrivial Cartesian product decomposition.
